card_info.title: Card info
card_info.description: What an agent's card in the agents list shows beside its name, as Header info's template: the same keys, and {machine} (local for this computer), {remote} (another machine's name, else nothing), {space}. Each segment is a chip; {space} is left out where a space header or the name already says it. Empty: off. The shipped agents list draws it in place of the machine's name.
